# A `use_extension` whose label is computed could be any ruleset's: every
# ecosystem a ruleset builds is undetermined (design 2.9).

=== .bazelversion
9.3.2
=== MODULE.bazel
module(name = "app")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_python", version = "1.4.1")

EXTENSION = "@rules_python//python/extensions:pip.bzl"

pip = use_extension(EXTENSION + "", "pip")
pip.parse(
    hub_name = "pypi",
    python_version = "3.11",
    requirements_lock = "//:requirements.txt",
)
use_repo(pip, "pypi")
=== requirements.txt
six==1.16.0
